unit_policy: Fruit prices are normalized to EGP/kg unless product_catalog.json marks the product as piece.

sources.name: Akhbarelyom - Obour wholesale fruit prices
sources.notes: Wholesale Obour Market ranges. The article states retail markets usually add 3 to 5 EGP/kg, so retail min/max seeds add that spread.

sources.name: Carrefour Egypt - Fruits category
sources.notes: Online retail prices were normalized from listed package sizes such as 500g, 750g, 1kg, 2kg, and 125g.

sources.name: ElObour Store - Fresh and bulk fruits
sources.notes: Retail and bulk online store prices. Bulk crates/cartons were converted by the approximate weights shown in product names.

sources.name: MVP synthetic completion
sources.notes: Small synthetic samples fill sparse products needed by the detector MVP, especially cherry, cherry_tomato, blueberry, and pineapple.

normalization_examples.raw: Obour summer orange 10-14 EGP/kg wholesale plus 3-5 EGP/kg retail spread
